{{Top|leg}}
The '''Nirrani tribe''' was a [[Tarasin]] [[irstat]] that lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. The Tarasin [[Kaylanna]] served as the tribe's [[Irstat-Kes]] and when [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Darrus Jeht/Legends|Darrus Jeht]] summoned the Tarasin leaders to hold a ''[[vurgat]]'' ceremony, Kaylanna represented her tribe at the proceedings.
